EcoMug is GPL-3.0 licensed. Its v2.1 header is vendored so cluster builds do
not need network access. The former `musrSim_upgrade` source and EcoMug version
are unavailable; a new sample must be identified by this repository revision
and generator version, then compared statistically with the historical sample.
